units.source_text: 京中派人前来迎接，庆祝公子疟疾痊愈。

en.t: People from the capital came to meet him and celebrate the young lord's recovery from malaria.
Messengers from the palace also arrived.

units.source_text: 僧都办了俗世所无的果物，又穷搜远采，罗致种种珍品，为公子送行。

en.t: The bishop prepared fruits unlike anything found in the ordinary world, searched far and wide for rare delicacies, and gathered all kinds of precious gifts to see the young lord off.

units.source_text: 他说：“贫僧立下誓愿，今年不出此山，因此未能远送。

en.t: He said, "This humble monk has made a vow not to leave this mountain this year, so I cannot accompany you far on your departure.

units.source_text: 此次匆匆拜见，反而增人离思。”

en.t: Meeting you only briefly like this has merely deepened the sorrow of parting."
Then he offered wine to the young lord.

units.source_text: 公子答道：“此间山水美景，使我恋恋不舍。

en.t: The young lord replied, "The beautiful mountains and waters here make me reluctant to leave.

units.source_text: 只因父皇远念，我心惶恐，理应早归。

en.t: But because my imperial father is worrying about me from afar, I feel uneasy and ought to return soon.

units.source_text: 山樱未谢之时，当再前来访晤。

en.t: Before the mountain cherries have finished blooming, I shall come again to visit you."
